basic_details.job_title: ESIC Ranchi Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 87 Professor, Associate Professor and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident
basic_details.short_information: ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Ranchi has 87 teaching posts to fill on contract: 41 Senior Residents, 16 Assistant Professors, 19 Associate Professors and 11 Professors across 24 departments. Applications must reach the college by 2 November 2026. You can send them by Speed Post, by hand or by email, and the notice recommends email. Interviews are tentatively planned for 5 or 6 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Pay the fee by Demand Draft in favour of "ESIC Saving Fund A/c No.-2", payable at Namkum, and send it with the application form. The fee is not refunded under any circumstances.

age_limit.age_details: Contract, 1 year (extendable every year up to a maximum of 3 years)

qualification.details: Age relaxation will be given under the prevailing norms of the Government of India. | All posts: as per the National Medical Commission (NMC, erstwhile MCI) guidelines dated 30.06.2025. | All candidates must hold an up-to-date medical registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council covering all their post-MBBS/MD/MS qualifications. If your registration has not been updated yet, show and submit a copy of the "Applied for" document at the interview. If you do not, you may not be interviewed or your result may be withheld, and selected candidates must produce the updated registration certificate when they join. | For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification and the NMC guidelines it refers to.

selection_process: Selection depends on your academic credentials and your performance in an interview before the Selection Board. After the applications are scrutinised
the exact interview date will be published on the ESIC recruitments page with the list of candidates and departments

or emailed to candidates directly. Being called for interview is provisional and depends on a detailed check of your eligibility. The result will be shown in the Recruitment section of the ESIC website
and offers of appointment will be sent by email only.
how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the prescribed format. Submit a separate application for each post. Applications in any other format, or incomplete ones, will be rejected.
Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below, plus the Demand Draft for Rs. 500/- if your category has to pay the fee.

Send the application by email (the notice recommends this for speed), by Speed Post or by hand to ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Purulia Road, Namkum, Ranchi - 834010. The email address printed on the notice is [email protected].
Make sure the application reaches the office by 2 November 2026. Late applications will not be considered.
Watch the ESIC recruitments page and your email for the interview date, then report on the scheduled date and time with your original documents.
Class-X marksheet or certificate as proof of date of birth
All marksheets, attempt certificates and the degree certificate of MBBS
All marksheets, attempt certificates and the degree certificate of MD/MS/DNB/other examination
Valid EWS/OBC/SC/ST/PwD certificate in the Central Government format, wherever applicable. The EWS certificate must be based on F.Y. 2025-26 and issued on or after 01.04.2026.
Proof of publications and experience certificates
Certificate for completing the ICMR/NMC Bio-medical research examination and the Revised/Basic Medical Education Workshop, if any
Relieving certificate or NOC from your previous or current employer, if applicable

Originals of all these documents will be checked at the interview and again at joining. Candidates working in a Government, autonomous or statutory institution should preferably bring an NOC. If you do not have it yet, bring a copy of your application for the NOC. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: About ESIC Ranchi
content_sections.text: The Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) is a statutory body set up under an Act of Parliament. It works under the administrative control of the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India. ESIC Medical College and Hospital is on Purulia Road, Namkum, Ranchi - 834010, and its Dean is recruiting faculty for the proposed medical college on behalf of ESIC.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Pay the fee by Demand Draft in favour of "ESIC Saving Fund A/c No.-2", payable at Namkum, and send it with the application form. The fee is not refunded under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection depends on your academic credentials and your performance in an interview before the Selection Board. After the applications are scrutinised, the exact interview date will be published on the ESIC recruitments page with the list of candidates and departments, or emailed to candidates directly. Being called for interview is provisional and depends on a detailed check of your eligibility. The result will be shown in the Recruitment section of the ESIC website, and offers of appointment will be sent by email only.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Tenure: 1 year, extendable every year up to a maximum of 3 years if performance is satisfactory, or until a regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. The engagement can last until you turn 70 at most. It gives no claim to regularisation or to preference for a regular post. Leave: 2.5 days of paid leave for each completed month. This is earned leave under the CCS Leave Rules, 1972, with no encashment, no half leave and no advance leave. Holidays and Sundays that fall within a leave period count as leave. Security deposit: Rs 30,000/-, interest-free, paid at joining by Demand Draft in favour of "ESIC Saving Fund Account No.2", payable at Namkum. It is refunded after the contract is completed and you produce a no-dues certificate. Notice period: Either side can end the contract with one month's notice. If you resign on the spot, you must deposit one month's salary into the ESI account by Challan. Agreement: You sign an agreement with the Dean on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs.100/-, at your own cost. Private practice of any kind is prohibited, and so is working as teaching faculty at another hospital or medical college at the same time. There are no PF, pension, gratuity, seniority or promotion benefits, and no accommodation is provided. Income tax and professional tax are deducted every month. Attendance is marked both manually and on the Aadhaar Enabled Bio-metric Attendance System (AEBAS). Being absent for more than 7 days without permission counts as abandoning the job and ends the contract automatically.

faq.question: Q1. Which department has the most Senior Resident vacancies?
faq.answer: Anaesthesiology has 7 Senior Resident posts (02 SC, 01 ST, 03 OBC, 01 EWS), followed by Medicine with 6.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for a Senior Resident in Pathology or Anatomy?
faq.answer: It is 50 years for Anatomy, Biochemistry, Physiology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Pathology, Forensic Medicine and Community Medicine. All other departments have a 45-year limit, counted on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q3. Do women candidates pay the application fee?
faq.answer: No. Female, SC, ST, PH and Defence Ex-servicemen candidates pay nothing. Everyone else pays Rs. 500/- by Demand Draft payable at Namkum.

faq.question: Q4. Can retired doctors apply for Professor posts?
faq.answer: Yes, up to an age of 69 years. Retired employees and pensioners draw the full pay without deduction and keep receiving their pension and dearness relief.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any deposit to pay after selection?
faq.answer: Yes. You pay an interest-free security deposit of Rs 30,000/- by Demand Draft at joining. It is refunded after the contract is completed and you produce a no-dues certificate.

faq.question: Q6. How will I know my interview date?
faq.answer: The tentative dates are 5 and 6 November 2026. The exact date will be posted on the ESIC recruitments page with the list of candidates, or emailed to you after the applications are scrutinised.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply for two departments or posts with one form?
faq.answer: No. You must submit a separate application for each post in the prescribed format, or it will be rejected.

faq.question: Q8. Is accommodation provided?
faq.answer: No, the college does not provide accommodation. Private practice and teaching at another medical college are also prohibited.

faq.question: Q9. How much leave do I get on this contract?
faq.answer: You earn 2.5 days of paid leave for each completed month, with no encashment. Salary is deducted for any leave taken beyond that.
